Zechariah prays for good offspring and is given tidings of John despite old age and a barren wife, with the sign that he cannot speak for three days.
Zechariah, old and with a barren wife, privately asks his Lord for an heir and is given news of a son named John, with the sign of three nights' silence.
Zechariah asked not to be left without an heir; Allah answered, gave him John and amended his wife; they hastened to good deeds and supplicated in hope and fear.
